summary: End-to-end backend (pytest, 38 tests) + frontend (Playwright) testing of Naija Invest MVP. Initial run found multiple 500s caused by MongoDB ObjectId in API responses on POST endpoints (insert_one mutates dict in-place adding _id). Fixed by popping _id after insert in /invest, /withdrawal/request, /admin/products, /admin/coupons. All 38 backend tests pass including 24h payout simulation + 3-gen referral commission cascade. Frontend flows verified: admin login (08123456789/personally), user register w/ ₦750 welcome bonus, dashboard, invest, deposit (mock), withdraw, referrals, admin products CRUD UI.

minor.issue: FIXED by testing agent — POST /invest, /withdrawal/request, /admin/products, /admin/coupons returned 500 due to MongoDB _id leaking into response after insert_one mutated the doc. Patched with doc.pop('_id', None) after insert.

issues: Stat card labels (TOTAL USERS, ACTIVE INVESTMENTS, TOTAL INVESTED, TOTAL DEPOSITS, TOTAL WITHDRAWN, PENDING WITHDRAWALS) appear very faint — extremely low contrast against the white card background; numbers/headings are readable but labels are barely legible.
Card image area is blank/empty grey — consider rendering a 'No image' placeholder like the Invest page does.

action_items: Increase contrast of admin stat-card labels for readability.
Optional: add a placeholder image/style for product cards with empty image_url in the admin Products grid.
Optional cleanup: residual TEST_PROD product from earlier failed test run is visible in admin Products; main agent may delete or re-seed the products collection.
Consider repeating the doc.pop('_id', None) pattern (or a small helper) across any future insert+return endpoints to prevent regression.
critical_code_review_comments: All POST endpoints that insert a Mongo doc and return it must strip _id before returning (root cause of the 500s). Fix applied to 4 endpoints, but worth standardising via a helper.
/api/auth/me triggers process_investment_payouts on every call — fine for MVP but will become a hot path; consider moving to a background scheduler.
JWT_SECRET falls back to a hardcoded dev secret if env var missing — set JWT_SECRET in production env.
/coupons/redeem and /invest do balance reads then $inc — minor race condition risk under concurrent calls; acceptable for MVP.
Settings PUT returns _id-stripped doc correctly because find_one excludes _id. Good pattern.
test_credentials: Admin: 08123456789 / personally. Test users created dynamically per run via /api/auth/register (phones prefixed 0807/0808).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create transient TEST_* users, a coupon (deleted at end of suite), and one TEST_PROD product (created, updated, deleted within test). One stray TEST_PROD remains from initial failed run before fix — non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is fully passing and reusable. It covers auth, products, deposits (mock), invest, withdrawals, coupons, referrals, transactions, admin CRUD, and a 24h payout + 3-gen cascade simulation via direct motor write to last_payout_at. Re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v.
rca_of_the_issue: Initial 500s on POST /invest, /withdrawal/request, /admin/products, /admin/coupons: motor's insert_one mutates the passed dict, adding a BSON ObjectId at key '_id'. The handlers then returned that same dict directly; FastAPI's jsonable_encoder failed to serialise ObjectId, raising ValueError and producing 500. Fix: call doc.pop('_id', None) immediately after insert_one before returning.
